dynamic_metadata_policy: Timestamp and Git HEAD are excluded from deterministic data artifacts and belong in later experiment run manifests.

source_selection.label_permutation_invariance_scope: Core test.jsonl and summary.json are invariant conditional on the frozen selected inputs. Provenance intentionally retains aggregate source-integrity counts and the pinned source-manifest hash.

claim_boundaries.irrelevant_distractor: This uses other selected test inputs transductively. Minimum lexical overlap does not prove semantic irrelevance.
claim_boundaries.lexical_contradiction: The inserted statement contradicts a high-overlap sentence excerpt; it is not guaranteed to contradict the ground-truth answer.
claim_boundaries.lexical_evidence_removal: This is a deterministic lexical-overlap proxy and is not guaranteed to remove semantically answer-bearing evidence.
claim_boundaries.severity: The conditions are categorical perturbations and must not be interpreted as a monotonic degradation scale.

transformation.experimental_unit_policy: The 2,400 rows are repeated conditions on 400 base inputs and must not be analysed as 2,400 independent examples.
transformation.input_id_policy: sha256(dataset_revision,source_split,source_index,input_sha256); answer-derived source-manifest IDs are validated then discarded
transformation.interpretation: Evaluation uses inherited original BoolQ targets under stress; transformations are not guaranteed to preserve answer validity.
